recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future change to the module's navigation wording or home-page reachability should be handled under a final navigation decision such as FHIR-52886 or a follow-up WG issue, not by reopening FHIR-49113.
issue_request: FHIR-49113 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 to create a Biologically Derived Product module page for BiologicallyDerivedProduct and related resources, based on the OO Confluence draft, and to add a Note to Implementers in the BiologicallyDerivedProduct Scope and Usage section. The recorded resolution approved the module and noted FHIR-I agreement to include it without Getting Started navigation until navigation was determined.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3273, merged as 1e0e9ba95277e98ba80903a446de4f8c93798ecd, added source/biologically-derived-product-module.html, the module diagrams, publish.ini page/image entries, hierarchy/modules-list entries, and a BiologicallyDerivedProduct Scope and Usage link to the module page.
additional_context: FHIR-49944 later refined the BDP module and resource-page implementer notes into styled stu-note blocks, and FHIR-49613 fixed stable anchors used by the module. Later source history removed related OO resources such as BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense and SupplyDelivery from the core build and pointed module links to the OO incubator IG. FHIR-52886 is a later unresolved navigation issue and was not decided here; commit 203dad3ce447b7094c867ef9b1e0cd5955a6bd39 subsequently reworked OO module navigation.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source contains the BDP module page, includes it in publish.ini, exposes it through current module/navigation files, keeps BiologicallyDerivedProduct active in fhir.ini, and contains the requested BiologicallyDerivedProduct Scope and Usage Note to Implementers linking to the module. Links for moved related resources now point to the OO incubator rather than stale core pages.
